Nokia extends 5G partnership with Taiwan Mobile to build AI-native networks

•	Nokia signed a 5G expansion agreement with Taiwan Mobile to accelerate AI-native mobile networks across Taiwan.

•	Nokia will deploy its latest AirScale portfolio, including next-generation baseband and radio solutions.

•	The deal adds advanced software to enhance Taiwan Mobile’s existing network infrastructure.

•	The partnership targets new 5G services and monetization opportunities.

AI across the network

•	AI for Network: Nokia will add AI-powered software for real-time automation and predictive analytics, including Predictive Hardware Analytics (PHWA) and MantaRay SON (self-organizing network).

•	Network for AI: Next-gen baseband and radio solutions will boost capacity and uplink…

The Trade Desk ($TTD) integrated retail purchase data from Seven-Eleven Japan into its platform.

•	Advertisers can programmatically activate SEJ’s retail data across digital channels.

•	The capability is now available to all advertisers in Japan.

•	This is one of Japan’s leading examples of integrating SEJ purchase data with a DSP (demand-side platform).

Scale and data access

•	Advertisers can activate audience segments from ~28 million 7-Eleven App members.

•	SEJ operates Japan’s largest convenience store network with about 22,000 stores and roughly 20 million daily visitors.

*STRIPE, ADVENT OFFER TO BUY PAYPAL FOR $60.50/SHARE: REUTERS



Payments company Stripe and private equity ​firm Advent International have made ‌a joint offer to acquire PayPal Holdings Inc (PYPL) for $60.50 per ​share, in a deal ​that would value the payments ⁠company at more than $53 ​billion, two people familiar with ​the matter said.



The offer, submitted earlier this month, is backed by about $50 ​billion in committed financing ​from banks, the people said, and ‌represents ⁠around a 28% premium to PayPal's closing share price on Tuesday.

Bell Canada starts testing a Quebec ground station connected to AST SpaceMobile’s ($ASTS) satellite constellation, advancing plans for satellite-to-mobile coverage.

Milestone + Partnership

•	Bell completes a ground station in Quebec, a key step toward space-based cellular coverage.

•	Station links Bell’s terrestrial network with AST SpaceMobile’s ($ASTS) low-earth orbit satellite constellation.

•	Partnership was first announced last fall to launch space-based cellular service.

Goal + Timeline

•	Technology aims to keep Bell customers connected in areas beyond traditional wireless coverage.

•	Bell targets launch of satellite coverage in early 2027.

Kratos ($KTOS) opens a 167,000 sq ft facility in York, PA, expanding capacity for hypersonic, missile, radar and directed-energy programs.

New Facility

•	167,000 sq ft defense manufacturing site in York, PA, backed by $7M+ in new production equipment

•	PA operations now span three facilities with 440+ employees

Programs & Capabilities

•	Boosts mil-spec hardware production for hypersonic, air defense, missile, radar and C-UAS programs

•	Manufactures systems for High Power Microwave (HPM) and High Energy Laser (HEL) programs, including custom mechanical, thermal and electrical subsystems

•	Adds advanced manufacturing, systems integration and testing capabilities to speed up mission-critical production

Warren Buffett says he personally initiated Berkshire’s Alphabet ($GOOGL) investment, even as Greg Abel now serves as CEO and final decision-maker.

Alphabet Investment

•	Buffett: “I initiated it”; says he and Abel operate on mutual approval, but Abel “is the decider”

•	Berkshire first disclosed its Alphabet stake in Q3 2025, later expanding the holding

•	Earlier this year, Berkshire joined a $10B private placement to fund Alphabet’s AI infrastructure

Buffett’s View on Alphabet

•	Says investing goal is finding businesses with high returns on capital over time

•	Calls Alphabet a sizable holding but not among his favorites, ranking it below 4-5 other Berkshire businesses

•	Flags AI capital intensity as a key risk: Google and rivals now spending “hundreds of bil…

Amazon Leo partners with Herotel, South Africa’s largest fixed ISP, to launch evry, a satellite-powered service targeting rural connectivity starting 2027.

The Deal & Tech

•	Herotel will use Amazon Leo’s satellites to power new service evry, launching commercially 2027 — first such deal in Africa

•	Targets millions in rural areas, farms and small towns underserved by traditional infrastructure due to distance, terrain and low density

•	Amazon Leo satellites orbit ~590km (vs 35,000km+ for geostationary), enabling lower latency for video calls, streaming, remote work and learning via compact antennas, no fiber/fixed wireless needed

Herotel’s Existing Footprint

•	Serves 350,000+ customers across 550+ towns via fiber/fixed wireless, with 120 local offices that will support evry’s installation, service and field operations from launch

Keel Infrastructure ($KEEL) secures City of Sherbrooke approval to consolidate 96 MW of power and purchase land for a new HPC/AI data center campus.

Power Agreement

•	City approved deal with Hydro-Sherbrooke to consolidate three Bitcoin mining sites into one 96 MW campus, with no additional power requested

•	Usage recategorized from BTC mining to HPC/AI

•	Capacity transfer still needs approval from Québec’s Ministry of Economy, Innovation and Energy

Land Purchase

•	Signed agreement for a parcel ~100 miles east of Montréal

•	Subject to site inspections, feasibility analysis and municipal approvals; expected to close Q1 2027

Redwire ($RDW) wins $21.5M in Q2 2026 follow-on orders for the Marine Corps’ PAE RAS Small UAS program, building on $20M in Q1 2026 contracts.

The Awards

•	$21.5M in follow-on purchase orders received in Q2 2026, supporting the PAE RAS Family of Small UAS program

•	Follows $20M in Q1 2026 Marine Corps contracts, showing continued order momentum

•	Includes a second Advanced Stalker Block 30 system; procurement completed via DLA Tailored Logistics Support contract with Atlantic Diving Supply as prime contractor

Program Scope

•	Marine Corps continues upgrading hundreds of existing Stalker UAS platforms

•	Advanced Navigation upgrade enhances ISR, target tracking and situational awareness

IREN ($IREN) appoints Eric Hammersley as CISO, backing security across its AI Cloud platform as it scales data centers, compute and software.

The Appointment

•	Hammersley named Chief Information Security Officer, overseeing security across data centers, compute and software as IREN’s AI Cloud expands

•	Brings 20+ years of cybersecurity experience

Background

•	Joins from Nutanix, where he served as Chief Product Security Officer

•	Previously led software security architecture at NVIDIA ($NVDA)

•	Held senior engineering roles across the U.S. federal government, including Chief Engineer supporting the Joint Chiefs of Staff

Xpeng ($XPEV) plans to scale Iron humanoid robot production past 1,000 units/month by year-end, ahead of a 2027 global rollout as showroom sales assistants.

Production & Rollout Plan

•	Targets 1,000+ units/month capacity for Iron by end of 2026, enabling 2027 global expansion

•	Deploys Iron as China showroom sales assistants in Q1 2027, expanding to overseas stores later that year, then broader households starting 2028

•	Built a 110,000 sqm production base in Guangzhou, spanning R&D, trial production and scaled manufacturing

Robot & Tech Specs

•	Iron stands 178cm, weighs 70kg, powered by all-solid-state batteries

•	Runs 3 Xpeng-developed Turing AI chips (2,250 TOPS combined), linked to second-gen VLA large model

Strategic Context

•	Reflects Xpeng’s shift fro…

Eos Energy ($EOSE) guides to record Q2 revenue of $68-69M and a record $807M backlog, as shipments triple year-over-year.

Revenue & Shipments

•	Expects Q2 revenue of $68-69M, a record high, with shipments up 3x+ YoY

•	H1 2026 revenue already exceeds all of 2025 revenue

Margins & Production

•	Gross margin expected in a loss range of -69% to -73%

•	Battery Line 2 began commercial production in mid-June 2026

•	Targets a multi-GWh annual manufacturing run-rate by year-end

Backlog & Cash

•	Backlog hit a record $807M, up 25% sequentially

•	Total cash (incl. restricted) approximately $364M

•	Customer collections of ~$78M, exceeding quarterly revenue

European Commission will issue hundreds of millions of euros in fines against Google ($GOOGL) this week, plus threats of daily penalties under the Digital Markets Act (DMA).

The Fines

•	EU to issue separate fines against Google over two long-running probes, alongside threats of daily penalty payments and new DMA regulatory orders

•	One probe: Google allegedly favors its own shopping/travel/specialized services over rivals in search results

•	Other probe: Google must give Play Store app developers more freedom to direct users to alternative app systems

Nebius ($NBIS) unveils a new model pairing its AI cloud platform with partner-owned data centers, adding capacity with minimal incremental capital.

The Model

•	Partners finance, own the infrastructure/hardware and operate the data centers

•	Nebius supplies systems architecture, supply-chain access, and deploys/maintains its hardware design, software and services stack on partner infrastructure

•	Nebius markets the resulting capacity via its global sales organization, connecting it directly to customers

Who It’s For

•	Opens a route into the AI cloud market for data center developers, infrastructure investors, regional operators and national AI projects worldwide

Value Proposition

•	Partners get fully-owned AI infrastructure assets built to Nebius standards, w…

Archer ($ACHR) launches Zee, an aviation-focused AI foundation model built on large-scale real-world flight data to improve safety and operational efficiency.

Zee Model & Data

•	Zee is an aviation-specific foundational AI model integrating ADS-B, ATC, maps, aircraft, terrain and weather data.

•	Trained on real-world data from 6,000+ ADS-B receivers, giving broad coverage of flight operations and airspace conditions.

•	Supports both on-device offline deployment and server-hosted deployment, targeting constrained edge devices and centralized systems.

Target Use Cases

•	Platform aimed at air taxis, UAVs, commercial airlines and air traffic management systems.

•	Goal is to create an “intelligence layer” for the aviation system, improving flight safety, efficiency and scale across U.S. airspace.

Alibaba ($BABA) U.S.-listed shares rose about 4% premarket after confirming its Qwen AI model will be integrated into Apple Intelligence for China-based users.

Integration Details

•	Alibaba says Qwen will be integrated into Apple Intelligence experiences across iOS, iPadOS, macOS and visionOS for users in China.

•	Chinese regulators’ Cyberspace Administration have included Apple AI services on a list of approved providers alongside Chinese firms such as Huawei.

•	Integration lets users access Qwen’s text and image understanding/generation capabilities without switching between tools, per Alibaba.

Market Reaction & Context

•	Alibaba ADRs gained about 3.7–4% in U.S. premarket trading following the news.

•	The approval follows a lengthy process since Apple Inte…

Nokia launches the first commercial AI-RAN platform with Nvidia, targeting 50%+ spectral efficiency gains by 2027 and 100%+ by 2028.

Platform Details

•	Built on Nokia anyRAN software and Nvidia Aerial AI-RAN.

•	Demonstrated >20% spectral efficiency gains in trials, with goals of ~50% by 2027 and >100% by 2028.

•	Supports 4G, 5G and future 6G networks, with commercial availability planned for 2027.

•	Marvell supplies AI-accelerated merchant silicon for the platform.

Strategic Framing

•	Nokia CEO Justin Hotard: calls AI-RAN the biggest radio innovation in decades, unlocking more performance from existing spectrum.
